title: Delphi research result
description: What `research_result` returns to a host agent (specs/066 §4; crates/delphi-core/src/research.rs). A claim's `knowledge_status` is never raised by its source being trusted (specs/052).

answer.description: Model synthesis, labelled not validated. Raw page text is never returned.

new_claims.description: Deduplicated staged candidates, not search hits.

coverage.description: `thin` when the knowledge base and the trusted sources together gave fewer kept, cited claims than `[research] thin_below` (specs/098 section 7.5).

coverage_report.description: What each rung of the source ladder (specs/098 section 7.1) turned up and kept. A `reason` appears only on a rung that was searched and found nothing, or cannot be reached from inside; it is one word of a fixed list and never provider text.

counted.description: Kept, cited claims from the knowledge base and the trusted sources, after dedupe.

host_rungs.description: When thin: the rungs the host's own tools and connectors can take over.

leads_kept.description: Search results the fetcher would not reach, kept as noted leads.

signature.description: The identity line in the form chosen by [mcp] badge_style: the same string as `display`, kept for hosts that read it.

display.description: The one line a host prints first (specs/087 section 5.2): the badge, the name and `(role, via delphi)`, in the form [mcp] badge_style names and, for ansi, the colour pair [mcp] badge_mode names. On a Council result it is followed by the ruling card.

boundary_line.description: Advice: `── Name (role) takes over: reason ──`, for when the speaker changes (specs/087 section 5.4). A host may drop it.

return_line.description: Advice: the matching line for when control comes back.

from_trusted_source.description: Provenance only; does not change knowledge_status.

hex_light.description: The colour for a light terminal (specs/087 section 5.1).

via.description: Present when a host adopted the role. It does not change how the identity reads: the line always ends `, via delphi)` (specs/087 section 5.3).
